_comment: Copy to firm_boards.json (git-ignored) and replace the example entries with real staffing-firm boards. Use probe_boards.py to find sites a plain script can read. type wp_feed: url is a WordPress job RSS feed, searched with ?s=<query>. type jsonld_list: url is a search page with {q} for the query; job links containing link_pattern are opened and read from their schema.org JobPosting data. tier: vendor (usually accepts C2C) or big (mostly W2).
